Maya R: hey team — I'm Maya (started today on infra). I need access to Console staging and the feature-flags admin role in prod to test a rollout. I have Okta SSO set up. Who should I ping for these? :wave:
Sam (IT): welcome Maya! For staging I can add you directly. For prod feature-flags-admin we need a Jira ticket + manager approval. Can you open a ticket at https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/IT-ACCESS and tag @sam? Include your manager's email.
Maya R: thanks — opening now. do you need any specific role name?
Sam (IT): yes please request role `feature-flags-admin` and env=prod. For staging request `console-staging-admin`. I'll do staging right away.
Elena - DevEx: FYI our devex doc has the exact steps for flag toggles: https://docs.redwood.ai/dev/onboarding/feature-flags. Also note that the admin UI is Console -> Settings -> Feature flags -> Admin. When toggling, prefer gradual % rollout and add an audit note.
Tom - Eng: also, you can check flag state via the infra API:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  https://internal-api.redwood.ai/v1/flags/your-flag
```
On prod, don't use personal tokens — request a service token via IT.
Sam (IT): staged access granted. @Maya R you should be able to log into https://staging.console.redwood.ai now. Reply when confirmed.
onboard-bot: Ticket IT-4573 created by Maya R for prod access, assigned to Sam (IT).
Maya R: I can log in to staging, console shows the feature flags page. thx! :tada:
Sam (IT): great. For prod next steps — include your manager @Lina in the Jira ticket. Once approved I'll kick off the approval workflow. Expect 24-48h.
Maya R: added @Lina and updated the ticket with justification. Thanks all!
Elena - DevEx: welcome aboard Maya, ping me if you want a quick walkthrough on the flag rollout dashboard.
Maya R: will do, appreciate it :)
